thread:
chris: Heads-up: APAC free-tier latency spiking ~5-10x for the last 18m. Console shows a big chunk routed to us-west instead of apac-n.
chris: Snapshot from the routing trace view: `route_count(apac-free -> us-west) = 18k`, avg p95 latency up from 120ms to 1.2s.
meera: Yikes. Any recent policy changes for free-tier routing or fallback behavior?
chris: I pulled the audit: kevin pushed a policy change 22m ago toggling `prefer_cost_variant: true` for free-tier, and we also lowered variant-compat TTLs.
kevin: That was intentional — reduce spend on free accounts by preferring quantized-small variants. I didn't expect cross-region ejections, though. The change should be region-local.
chris: The problem is the fallback path: when the preferred small variant in apac isn't available, the router falls back to the cheapest compatible *region-level* variant and then the routing policy allows cross-region dispatch without enough guard. That creates a feedback loop: higher latency -> more fallbacks -> capacity pressure in us-west -> more ejections -> more cross-region.
anya: Could we short-circuit fallback for free-tier in regions with >SLO latency? Even temporary?
meera: Agreed. Temp mitigation: disable cross-region fallback for apac for free-tier, and flip `prefer_cost_variant` back to false while we investigate.
kevin: I'm on it. Pushing a hotpatch to routing config to set `cross_region_fallback: false` for apac/free-tier and to raise `fallback_cooldown_ms` to 120000. Patch: ```json
{
  "policy": "tiered-routing",
  "overrides": {
    "apac": { "free": { "cross_region_fallback": false, "fallback_cooldown_ms": 120000 } }
  }
}
```
kevin: Deploying now (hotpatch id=hp-20240416-02).
routing-bot: hotpatch hp-20240416-02 applied to routing-config service in 00:18. Rollout: 15/15 nodes.
sre-bot: Alert resolved? p95 latency for apac-free dropped from 1.2s -> 180ms in the first 3 mins after the patch.
chris: Nice. Can we also add a guard in the routing evaluation to prevent selecting a remote variant if the estimated RTT delta > 200ms or if the variant compatibility is not 100% (we saw a quantization mismatch warning in the logs)?
meera: Yes — add a gating rule: `require_compatibility=true` and `max_remote_delta_ms=200`. File a follow-up ticket to make it configurable via Console rollouts UX.
kevin: I'll open the ticket and add a small telemetry event for "remote_variant_selected" with reason tags. That should help dashboards detect this faster.
chris: Also: the rollout UI should show variant compatibility matrix (quantization, dtype, tokenizer-hash) before a policy flip. Right now it's too easy to flip `prefer_cost_variant` without visibility.
anya: I'll sketch a mock for the Console change — add a red-warning banner if compatibility < 100% or cross-region enabled.
chris: For postmortem: add timeline, root cause (policy + fallback + cooldown too low), mitigation (hotpatch), and action items: 1) routing guard rule, 2) rollout UI change, 3) an automated alert when cross-region route rate for a tier > 2% baseline.
meera: Confirming I saw the hotpatch revert for `prefer_cost_variant` too (kevin?).
kevin: Reverted `prefer_cost_variant` for free-tier in apac. Hotpatch id hp-20240416-03. routing-bot: hp-20240416-03 applied.
chris: Thanks. I'll own the postmortem and the alert. Tagging @product-observability to decide the threshold.
meera: Moving to close — keep monitoring for 2h then we'll decide on long-term fixes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: Patch notes and ticket links: https://rwd/internal/tickets/RT-4321 (guard + telemetry), https://rwd/internal/hotpatches/hp-20240416-02
chris: Awesome — nice quick teamwork. If anyone sees any re-appearance ping this thread. :thumbsup:
